# commons-graph

> A Kotlin/JVM directed property graph library with typed entities, Storage backends and label-based visibility.

## Instructions for Agents

- Read the relevant API page before constructing a Graph, Entity or Storage.
- Construct bound entities through Graph factory methods.
- Configure graph identity, entity factories and optional Label hierarchy as the Graph API requires.
- Choose a Storage implementation for the caller’s persistence and concurrency requirements.
- Never put language-specific analysis policy in this library.

## Graph API

- [Graph](llms/graph.md): Graph construction, entity operations and structural queries.
- [Entities](llms/entity.md): Bound entity properties and delegates.
- [Labels](llms/label.md): Label hierarchy and label-selected queries.
- [Algorithms](design-algorithm.md): Graph algorithm function contracts and caller examples.

## Storage API

- [Storage](llms/storage.md): Storage operations, constructor settings and concurrent-use constraints.

## Optional

- [Documentation index](index.md): Current design, specifications and external API notes.
- [API page index](llms/index.md): File list for the API pages and generated aggregate.
